meta.name: Koparan Kardesler
meta.description: Orhan Koparan and his brother Naylon make their living by maintaining the graves of the deceased in the company they have named Koparan Brothers. Wanting to grow their business, the brothers decide to bid for a shroud tender at the municipality one day. However, they are unaware that the winner of the tender has already been decided beforehand. During the bidding process, the Koparan brothers cause a series of incidents, making enemies in the process, and find themselves caught up in various tragicomic events.
